entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. This call may be recorded for quality assurance. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I want to return something. I bought a VeloBand Pulse a little while ago, and it's just not working out for me.
Okay, I can help with that. Can you please provide me with your order number or the email address associated with the purchase?
It's [customer's email address]. Hurry this up, I don't have all day.
Thank you. One moment while I pull up your order... Okay, I see you purchased a VeloBand Pulse on [date of purchase, 15 days prior]. What is the reason for the return?
Like I said, it's just not for me. The heart rate monitor is inaccurate. I want a full refund.
I understand. Let me check our return policy for the VeloBand Pulse. Our standard return window is 10 days from the date of purchase. I see your purchase was made 15 days ago.
What?! Ten days? That's ridiculous! I didn't even get a chance to properly test it out. This is terrible service. I want my money back!

I apologize for the inconvenience. According to our policy, the return window has unfortunately closed. However, while I can't offer a full refund, I can offer you store credit for the full purchase price of the VeloBand Pulse. This way, you can choose another product from VeloFit that better suits your needs.
Store credit? Seriously? I wanted my money back. Is there anything else you can do? This VeloBand Pulse was faulty; I'm sure you could make a policy exception, right?

I understand your frustration, and I wish I could offer a full refund. I have reviewed your account, and while I cannot override the return window, I can add a 20% discount to your store credit as a further gesture of goodwill. That would give you even more purchasing power to find a VeloFit product you'll love.
Hmm, 20% on top of the store credit, you say? So, I can get something else from your store? Okay, I guess that's better than nothing. What's the process for getting this store credit?

Great! I've already added the store credit to your account. You'll receive an email within the next hour confirming the amount and detailing how to use it during checkout on our website or in our stores. Just use the code provided in the email when you're ready to make your next purchase.
Alright. I think I understand. Thank you for your help.
You're welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Actually, thank you for going the extra mile with the extra credit. I appreciate it.
My pleasure! Thank you for being a VeloFit customer. Have a great day!
